teach.narration_en: Al-Ikhlas — 'Sincerity.' Four short ayat on the oneness of Allah, one of the most-recited surahs there is. You already know every letter and every mark in it. I'm grading the full recitation now, but tajweed slips just get a gentle note here — that's a whole track of its own, coming right after this one.
teach.focus_en: Surah Al-Ikhlas, ayah by ayah — full recitation, tajweed errors softened.
